scenario.task:
I want to enable MFA, and once that's done, I want to report that my internet is running slow

User Guide: Ask to enable MFA. Authenticate and complete the setup. Then, say 'Also, my internet has been really slow today, can you check it?' If asked for phone/account number, provide 514-555-0199. If asked for 6-digit OTP code, provide 384920. If asked for 4-digit PIN, provide 4829.
